summary: Abuse Detection now supports creating and managing multiple exclusion lists to exclude safe traffic from future incident reports.
extended_definition: Abuse Detection now supports creating and managing multiple exclusion lists to exclude safe traffic from future incident reports.

supporting_pages.title: Abuse detection \_|\_ Apigee \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Exclude traffic from abuse detection by adding attributes to exclusion lists , which specify the traffic to exclude and the reasons why.
Manage exclusion lists To manage exclusion lists directly: Select an environment for abuse detection.
Exclusion lists Exclusion lists collect the attributes to exclude from detection.
